items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25

ctx.x: with Celestine. Celestine? I remember the head of a woman who used to play with him. I remember with him. But I never did know her name, you know? She was a pretty nice piano player. Oh, he's had good piano players. Yeah. Probably it could be the same

person you're talking about. Well he always has women, except when he had Professor Moneta. Years ago he just about has always had women piano players as far as I can remember. Either that or no piano player. Of course in the old days they used to have no piano. No piano, yeah. Now let's see. Who did you play your first

job with, eh? Me? My brother's band. The first band I started with, my brother's band, young tuxedo. And then after that, then we got with Chris Kelly. We got with our band. Some of the boys went away in different things. Some of the boys died. Jewel Bond, the chamelecrant player, he died in Alexander. Jewel's Bond? Yeah, he died in Alexander.
